chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-Hasan ibn Salih Al-Thawri, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The length of the ship of Noah (peace be upon him) was one thousand and two hundred cubits, and its width was eight hundred cubits, and its height in the sky was eighty cubits, and it spanned the space between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, and it circled the House seven circuits, then it settled upon Al-Judi.
ai.seo_question: What were the dimensions and miraculous journey of Noah's ship according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the miraculous nature of Noah's Ark by detailing its immense dimensions and a unique terrestrial journey that included spanning the distance between Safa and Marwa and circumambulating the Kaaba seven times before resting on Mount Judi. In Shia exegesis, these movements are often interpreted as signs of divine power and the Ark's role in preserving the faithful, linking the physical vessel to the spiritual geography of Mecca. The description underscores the Ark's significance not just as a survival craft, but as a sacred entity that participated in the rituals of monotheism.
